title: The Death of Moses

questions.question: Where did Moses go up to from the plains of Moab?
options: Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah
questions.correctAnswer: Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:1 (ESV): "Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah..."

questions.question: What did the Lord show him?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:1 (ESV): "And the Lord showed him all the land..."

questions.question: Who buried Moses?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:6 (ESV): "and he buried him in the valley in the land of Moab..."

questions.question: Does anyone know the place of his burial?
options: No one knows to this day
questions.correctAnswer: No one knows to this day
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:6 (ESV): "but no one knows the place of his burial to this day."

questions.question: How old was Moses when he died?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:7 (ESV): "Moses was 120 years old when he died."

questions.question: What was the condition of Moses' eyes and vigor?
options: His eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated
questions.correctAnswer: His eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:7 (ESV): "his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated."

questions.question: How long did Israel weep for Moses?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:8 (ESV): "And the people of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days."

questions.question: Who was full of the spirit of wisdom?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:9 (ESV): "And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom..."

questions.question: Why was Joshua full of wisdom?
options: For Moses had laid his hands on him
questions.correctAnswer: For Moses had laid his hands on him
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:9 (ESV): "for Moses had laid his hands on him."

questions.question: Has there arisen in Israel a prophet like Moses since?
options: No, whom the Lord knew face to face
questions.correctAnswer: No, whom the Lord knew face to face
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:10 (ESV): "And there has not arisen a prophet since in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face..."

questions.question: The land shown to Moses included as far as which sea?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:2 (ESV): "...and Judah as far as the western sea..."

questions.question: What city is called "the city of palm trees"?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:3 (ESV): "...the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees..."

questions.question: Moses is called what in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:5 (ESV): "So Moses the servant of the Lord died there..."

questions.question: To whom was the land sworn?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:4 (ESV): "This is the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob..."

questions.question: What did the people do to Joshua?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 34:9 (ESV): "...so the people of Israel obeyed him and did as the Lord had commanded Moses."

key_verse_text: And there has not arisen a prophet since in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face. (ESV)
